About

Drawn to patterns, wherever they show up

I'm drawn to patterns: the kind that surface in a security investigation, and the kind you follow row by row in a crochet chart. That habit of noticing what connects, and what's out of place, is what pulls me toward vulnerability analysis, SOC-style threat detection, and OT/ICS risk work, and toward sitting between technical detail and business decisions — whether that's a security audit or an incident report — so both sides actually understand each other.

My background spans vulnerability analysis, risk assessment, threat detection, and OT/ICS and compliance-aligned security work across enterprise and industrial environments, from SCADA and PLC risk assessments to SBOM-based vulnerability scoring.

Outside of that, the same energy goes into dancing, sketching, crocheting, singing, and creative writing, plus getting my Dutch past ordering coffee.

Skills

A toolkit for defensive security

Six areas that cover the ground from SOC operations and compliance audits to industrial (OT/ICS) risk assessments.

Security Tools

Wireshark, Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Metasploit, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, and Defender XDR for EDR/XDR investigation.

Security Operations

Vulnerability assessment, SBOM analysis, CVSS/EPSS prioritisation, risk modelling, threat detection, and incident documentation.

OT/ICS Security

SCADA, HMI, PLC, and RTU security assessment, plus cyber-physical risk thinking for operational resilience.

ML Security Research

Backdoor-attack evaluation and architecture vulnerability analysis across neural network benchmarks.

Frameworks & Compliance

MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, NIS2, and GDPR.

Programming & Systems

Python, C/C++, Java, and Bash across Linux distributions, VMware, and VirtualBox.

Projects

Things I built to break, then fix

FEB – JUN 2023

E-Wallet: Smart Card Application

A secure JavaCard e-wallet supporting personalisation, payment, reload, blocking, and decommissioning. Implemented authentication, PIN verification, and secure-channel protections (signatures, MACs, nonces, counters), mapping MITM, replay, fake-terminal, and PIN-guessing attacks to concrete safeguards.

OCT – DEC 2022

Fuzzing: Pixel-Sort Tool

Fuzzed an open-source C/C++ pixel-sorting tool using AFL, AFL++, Honggfuzz, Radamsa, and Zzuf, supported by sanitizers (ASan, MSan, Valgrind). Investigated crashes and timeouts, root-caused issues, and documented reproducible fixes.
